caption:
Skincare as Prelude

I think of morning skincare as pre-makeup.
At night, skincare nurtures the skin.
In the morning, it prepares the canvas.

It is still for the skin, of course —
but it should answer to your skin type,
the foundation you use, the finish you want,
and the climate you live in.

Singapore is always hot and humid,
yet indoors, the air conditioning is relentless and dry.
Here, skin and makeup are harder than in Japan.

The answer is to choose textures
that sink in quickly and hydrate deeply,
without leaving a film on the surface,
and to layer them with care.
The skin is moist within, never sticky on top.
Then, a thin veil of foundation.
The result is a natural glow, like your own skin,
that lasts the whole day.

Skincare, base, makeup —
not separate steps, but one continuous flow.
